name: i-Blue Internet
summary: Dialup-era ISP (iblue.com.au); defunct (STOJANOVSKI, VASKO (TRADING AS IBLUE) (sole trader), ABN 85 052 831 878).

events.details: Defunct. The ISP homepage died between Dec 2004 and Feb 2005 and the domain is a GPS shop from Aug 2006, promoting the c. 2005 proposal over the current c. 2003. ISP content gone by Feb 2005; GPS shop by Aug 2006.

refs.label: Dec 2004: last full retail ISP homepage (dialup/ADSL plans, webmail).
7 Feb 2005: homepage serves an empty HTML shell - ISP content already gone.
By Aug 2006 the domain was purely a GPS/electronics shop, confirming the ISP era ended c. 2005.
ABR: STOJANOVSKI, VASKO (TRADING AS IBLUE) ABN 85 052 831 878
